description: Single source of truth for plans, items, and progress. Narrative documents cite this file rather than restating it. Validated by scripts/roadmap.py: every evidence reference is resolved against the repository, so an item cannot claim completion by asserting it. Rendered to docs/ROADMAP.md.

plans.title: Convergence residuals, Metal 4 study, and Stage 4
plans.goal: Close the open contract-phase residuals, work through the phone-gated evidence battery, and take Stage 4 as revised by the Metal 4 tensor feasibility study. Interleaved by cost; no item implies a release.

plans.title: Delivery instruction quality and Qwen3-TTS prompting
plans.goal: Establish from primary sources how Qwen3-TTS is meant to be prompted, then settle by measurement whether the shipped delivery-preset copy is the reason takes are reported as not reading like the requested emotion. No preset copy changes without evidence.

plans.title: Documentation governance and staleness control
plans.goal: Make documentation state machine-checkable: pin historical records against accidental modification, derive facts from code so prose cannot silently contradict them, and give agents a queryable index instead of a directory to glob.

items.title: Deterministic delivery-instruction contract gate

items.title: Short-versus-long instruction A/B
items.gate: Official-style short form against the shipped long form, identical seeds and cells, paired Wilcoxon with BH correction. RESULT: shipped wins 57 surviving features to 33 over 12 paired seeds; the register hypothesis is refuted and the InstructTTSEval prediction held.

items.title: English diction append: does it earn its place
items.gate: Delivery matrix with QWENVOICE_ENGLISH_DICTION_REINFORCEMENT=off against the shipped default. RESULT: prosodic null (28 vs 25 surviving features, mean recall 0.20 vs 0.22) over 13 paired seeds with a control that held 104/104 and 0/156. Intelligibility also tested and found saturated: 28 of 29 cells at 0.000 WER, so that instrument cannot discriminate. Append kept; knob stays registered.

items.title: Voice Design merge template versus plain concatenation
items.gate: Three arms over 8 paired seeds. RESULT: shipped labeled form best on all three metrics (46 features / 66.2% error / 0.338 recall) against plain (41 / 68.8% / 0.312) and anchored (35 / 68.8% / 0.312). Labeled-over-plain is directional, not settled; the firm result is that the borrowed quality anchor hurts. Kept as shipped.

items.title: Angry pitch-axis contradiction
items.gate: 23 seeds, angry.normal against angry.strong. RESULT: the expectation (+1) is correct -- shipped copy moves pitch +5.98 st, d=1.40, win 0.91. The conflicting 'lower clipped tone' clause is simply not followed, so the contradiction is textual with no acoustic counterpart. angry.strong is also the better copy at this power (7 features vs 4), reversing DP-3's underpowered per-cell reading and confirming the global strong choice needs no exception.
